purpose: Bounded export example, not the production comparison format.

semantics.bin_edges_and_counts: Original logged histogram values, without rebinning.
semantics.moments: Midpoint estimates, not exact tensor statistics.
semantics.quantiles: Containing-bin intervals for the logged finite-value population.
semantics.clocks: Enclosing W&B history-record coordinates, not exact optimizer-hook timestamps.
semantics.amp: Parameter values are not multiplied by the gradient scaler.
semantics.coordinate_identity: Individual tensor element values are not recoverable.
